write.detail: camera usb apply wrote the recipe "Window color" to C7 and returned verified_current_session with no issues; protected C1-C6 were checked unchanged.

readback.detail: Every written property and the name read back independently. Only Grain Off differs (written 1, read 6 or 7), the one documented equivalence.

exact_restore.detail: Restoring the decoded original C7 returned verified_current_session; a final read of all seven slots matched the session's first backup byte for byte.

restart_persistence.detail: After the camera was switched off and on, the written slot read back as written (maintainer-supervised).

private_material: Raw backups and camera identity stay with the owner and are not part of this fixture.
sources: modules/camera/README.md (Explicit USB use from the computer)
